quest.title: Rejoice With Me, for What Was Lost Is Now Found
quest.description: Though Jeht made quick work of Aderfi, who had been a traitor to the Tanit tribe, you can't help but wonder how Benben's doing after being entrusted to him...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x25000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: How... how could I forget...

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: I hope it's not too late. We should at least search around his tent...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jeht! ...What's going on? Are you going somewhere?

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: #Paimon and {NICKNAME}... You came just in time. There's something I gotta do right now... I need to go to Aderfi's place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aderfi?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Isn't he that traitor who made shady deals with the Fatui? ...Oh, Paimon knows! You wanna go see if there's any valuable stuff he left behind!

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: No, I'm not interested in his stuff at all.

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: The tribe has its own rules on dealing with the belongings of traitors like Aderfi. Hmph... if it weren't for the rules, I would no doubt burn everything down the first chance I get.

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: I'm going to his tent because...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Because of Benben, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh! Oh no, Benben's still over there at Aderfi's place!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jehhht... Why did you leave Benben with someone like him?

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: I—I didn't know he was a traitor!

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Anyway, I need to check on Benben as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, we should go with her!

choices.text: Then let's not wait any longer...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... Paimon hopes Benben's okay...

talks.objective: Look for clues in Aderfi's tent

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, it's Benben!

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: I'm glad Aderfi didn't get to take Benben away...

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Or perhaps you could say that everything here looks exactly the same as before.

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Did he really think he'd overturn the Matriarch and return to his tent safe and sound...? What a self-absorbed idiot.

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: But thanks to that, nothing bad happened to Benben.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You call this "nothing bad"? Ohh, poor Benben...

choices.text: How did it come to this...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, why is it lying on the ground...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, what happened to Benben? Everything seemed fine the last time we saw it...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: After leaving Khaj-Nisut, Benben gradually grew weaker... It looked like its parts were malfunctioning, and the sound of its beeps was getting lower...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Then it couldn't make any sounds or move at all. It felt as if I was watching its life slowly drain out.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: At that time, no one in the tribe knew what was going on with Benben except Aderfi.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: So I left Benben in his care...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh no... Is Benben gonna stay like this forever...?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: At the very least, Benben's still here with us. I'm sure we'll find a way to fix it, sooner or later...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But there's nothing we can work with...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Hmm, let me think. I remember Aderfi telling me that whatever's wrong with Benben, it's nothing too serious, and that it should be fixed within a few days...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Knowing him, if he performed some kind of investigation, he would've definitely left records behind. Let's have a look around the area!

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: If it really was "nothing too serious", maybe we could even try fixing Benben ourselves!

dialogues.speaker: Benben
dialogues.text: (Benben lies still on the ground without making any of its familiar beeping sounds.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey look, there's something over here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Doesn't look like investigation records to Paimon. It looks more like... a letter.

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: A letter? Let's open it up and see what's written inside!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The letter says Benben simply ran out of energy...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that Paimon thinks about it, Benben opened the gates to the Mausoleum of King Deshret for us and activated our clearance... It really helped a lot during our journey.

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: And even mechanical creatures like Benben get tired. Maybe it ran low on energy after doing so much for us.

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: The letter mentioned something called Energy Transformation Capacitors, but I didn't see anything like that in the tent.

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Could it be...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Doesn't look like it. If they were meant for repairing Benben, why would he try to hide them? Wouldn't it be more intuitive to use them right away?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Aha, I know! It must be because the transaction hasn't occurred yet!

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Aderfi didn't bring Benben to the transaction, so there shouldn't be any Energy Transformation Capacitors here anyway... There's only one question left: who did he strike the deal with?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Ha, that was a dumb question for me to ask. There's only one group outside the tribe he'll have dealings like this with...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: It's the Fatui!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What should we do now?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: What else? There's no negotiating with the Fatui. We go to the transaction site and steal the Capacitors from them!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Woohoo! Let's go steal them!

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: But Benben... We can't carry it with us in its current state, so we can't take it to the transaction site...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: It isn't safe to leave it alone either. I don't wanna put it in a risky situation ever again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon and {NICKNAME} will go raid the Fatui! You just wait here with Benben.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Let's raid the Fatui!

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: #I really wanna go myself, but... {NICKNAME}, Paimon, I'm counting on you to help Benben recover!

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: And... even though they're just a bunch of Fatui, you should still be careful...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry! Just leave it to us!

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: I don't really wanna stay here in this traitor's tent with Benben though. I'll take it to my place.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Let's meet up in my tent after you retrieve the Capacitors!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup yup! This won't be our first time!

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Precisely. Who else could it be?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Ah, I know what you mean! The transaction hasn't even taken place!

talks.objective: Head over to the designated location in the letter
Wait at the location of the secret meeting

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
dialogues.text: P—Please stop...

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
dialogues.text: Please have mercy... We're gonna get killed if you keep this up...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure sounds convincing coming from the one who's been beaten.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Talk!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Spit it out!

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
dialogues.text: Y—Yes, I'll tell you everything! Anything you want to know!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then start with what you know!

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
dialogues.text: W—We always had dealings with Aderfi... A—And it sounded like the Matriarch of the Tanit had a bias for Azariq... and the new girl.

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
dialogues.text: And I don't know why, but it seems like Azariq has gone missing too...

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
dialogues.text: That woman is cruel. She considers everyone who's no longer of any value to the tribe an eyesore... so Aderfi contacted us in order to maintain his status.

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
dialogues.text: Our business in the desert area never went according to plan, until... until we struck the deal with Aderfi.

choices.text: No longer of any value... What does that mean?

response.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
response.text: I don't know... I really don't! That has to do with the internal workings of the desert folks... But if I had to guess, it might've been because she thought we were no longer trustworthy...

response.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
response.text: ...And so she began to keep her distance, and Aderfi, who had been in frequent contact with us, was very distressed because of that...

response.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
response.text: After all, we can always leave this wretched place when needed. Aderfi, on the other hand, will be used by the tribe until he's no longer 'of value'. His life is virtually in their hands.

response.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
response.text: But he was extremely cunning. He somehow made us fulfill his every request, while we, on the other hand, never heard anything of the items we asked for...

response.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
response.text: And now the rumors say he's gotten himself in trouble... We weren't sure what exactly happened, but we saw it as a window of opportunity...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: An opportunity for what?

response.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
response.text: We assumed that there wouldn't be many opportunities for us to trade with Aderfi in the future, so we asked him to bring the special Primal Construct he mentioned in his letters...

response.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
response.text: If we could get a hold of that Primal Construct before we left this place for good, we would've still gained something...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, so you're here to steal stuff too? No wonder we couldn't find any goods OR the Energy Transformation Capacitors!

response.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
response.text: Hold on... Did you just say "too"?

choices.text: Yep. Now hand over the Capacitors.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Argh... Don't tell Paimon the Energy Transformation Capacitors are all made up!

response.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
response.text: No. The Energy Transformation Capacitors are very real, and there's a whole batch of them. They seem to be ancient relics, so we're not sure if any of them are still functional...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Tell us where these Energy Transformation Capacitors are!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Keep up the imposing tone, Paimon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hehe, Paimon will! ...Hey, {NICKNAME}, don't change the subject!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speak up! Tell us where the Capacitors are!

response.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
response.text: ...They're at a camp not far away from here. Here's the key to its entrance... I've told you everything I know...

response.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
response.text: Alright, alright, I'll make myself scarce.

choices.text: Don't get in our way ever again!
It's bad luck you ran into us.
This... business you're doing in the desert. What is it?

response.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
response.text: ...It's top secret.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #See, now {NICKNAME}'s mad! You wouldn't want to mess with {M#him}{F#her}!

response.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
response.text: Ugh...! Alright, alright! Please don't get mad, I'll tell! But it's... it's not like I know the full story...

response.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
response.text: We were asked to investigate the current situation of various desert tribes. After infiltrating them through making business offers, we aimed to attract the Sages' attention... and ultimately work to the benefit of the Lord Harbinger in Sumeru City.

response.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
response.text: Professor Froderock was looking for live specimens in the desert — he always defied The Doctor's orders... That's just pure jealousy, if you ask me.

response.speaker: Fatui Negotiator
response.text: Ahem, I've gone too far... Anyway, Aderfi had been our point of contact, and he was in charge of everything that had to do with trade.

talks.objective: Collect a certain number of Energy Transformation Capacitors

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Hmm... It looks like there's nothing useful here...

talks.objective: Give the Energy Transformation Capacitors to Jeht

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jeht!

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: How was it? You didn't get into trouble, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Everything went as smooth as it could! Look! We got the Energy Transformation Capacitors!

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Huh, so this is what Energy Transformation Capacitors look like... But how are we supposed to use them?

dialogues.speaker: Benben
dialogues.text: Beep... Beep-beep...

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Benben?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Benben connects to the Energy Transformation Capacitors and quickly extracts energy from them.

dialogues.speaker: Benben
dialogues.text: Beep-beep! Beep-beep!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! We resurrected Benben!

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Silly Paimon. Benben just woke up from a long nap, that's all!

dialogues.speaker: Benben
dialogues.text: Beep... Bee-eep...

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Hey, I wasn't worried! I knew you'd recover, no matter what!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph. "I don't wanna put it in a risky situation ever again..."

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Don't parrot me, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Benben
dialogues.text: Beep-beeep.

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: #Oh, yeah! {NICKNAME}, Benben says thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Even though Benben was lying still without saying anything, it knows everything you've done.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No need to thank me, Benben.

dialogues.speaker: Benben
dialogues.text: Beep!

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Mm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is anything else the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Even though Benben has woken up, it still looks like it could use some rest...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right! Have a good rest, Benben!

dialogues.speaker: Benben
dialogues.text: Beep-beep...

talks.objective: Head over to the secret meeting

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Energy Transformation Capacitors... I hope Benben will recover once we get them...

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: If you're still unsure, I can go with you!

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Okay. I'll wait for your good news... Please stay safe!
